description: This Java source file defines the `PolicyIdMissingException` class, a specific exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a schema version of a Thing requires a policy ID but it was missing. It includes exception handling logic, builder pattern implementation, and factory methods for construction during update and create operations.

classes.name: PolicyIdMissingException
classes.description: A final, immutable exception class indicating a missing policy ID requirement for schema versions of a Thing.

classes.name: PolicyIdMissingException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing instances of `PolicyIdMissingException` with a fluent API.

methods.name: fromThingIdOnUpdate
methods.description: Creates an instance of `PolicyIdMissingException` for update scenarios based on a Thing ID and headers.

methods.name: fromThingIdOnCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of `PolicyIdMissingException` for creation scenarios based on a Thing ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of `PolicyIdMissingException` from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the applicable schema versions supported by this exception class.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a copy of the exception with provided Ditto headers.
